fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-05-16, around 09:15, a cheque bearing a forged signature of the complainant for Rs. 2,50,000 was presented near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-05-19. Anand Krishnan (mobile 9000000088) was named as a possible person of interest. A witness, Siva Sekar, reachable on 9000000284, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00040, as the mobile number 9000000088 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Signature allegedly imitated on a cheque or agreement.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged signature, morning, mobile number, witness statement, main street, suspect, documents
